text_879e8653: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Roxaval Travels for organizing a truly wonderful and unforgettable trip for me and my family. Every part of the journey was well planned, allowing us to enjoy a stress-free and memorable holiday. A very special thanks to Mr. Bandula Priyanjith Jayakody for organizing the entire tour, offering us the best price with great flexibility, and for his continuous assistance and unlimited support throughout our stay. Your professionalism and dedication made a huge difference to our experience. My heartfelt appreciation also goes to Mr. Mangala Gunarathna, our tour guide and driver, for the entire trip. Thank you for your kindness, patience, safe driving, and extensive knowledge of Sri Lanka. You made every destination enjoyable and ensured we were comfortable and well looked after at all times. I highly recommend Roxaval Travels to anyone planning a trip to Sri Lanka. Thank you once again for creating unforgettable memories for my family. Wishing you continued success and all the very best!
text_b7feda0d: Incredibly my dream vacation in Sri Lanka happened with the help of this trusted and worth Roxaval travel. They made a week amazing itinerary to visit places in Sri Lanka like Sigiriya Rock, my dream Ella train experience, adventure in yala safari and relax to incredible beaches in Merissa and Bentota. They provided the best hotel to relax and made feel comfortable every stay. From the arrival until to the last day they provided the best transfer and transport for all the tours. It is amazing how they care and give the best memories in Sri Lanka. The sad part may be the last day and leaving as Sri Lanka feels like a home for me, the kindness of people amazing nature and beaches. I guaranteed to come back again for more memories with the help of Roxaval travel.
text_6813d176: I had an amazing 14-day trip around Sri Lanka, and a big part of it was thanks to my driver, Shachira. He was professional, careful, and always made sure I felt safe and comfortable. He helped me visit all the places I wanted to see, including Sigiriya, Kandy, Mirissa, Hikkaduwa, and Bentota, and even organised a tea factory visit when my plans in Ella changed. The trip was well organised but flexible, which made everything stress-free. Shachira's local knowledge, safe driving, and genuine care made the experience truly special. I highly recommend him to anyone travelling around Sri Lanka.
text_35950c86: Loved the resort's ambience and amazing hospitality! Special thanks to our guide and driver, Palith, for making it a beautiful and safe experience. Best recommendation for a solo lady traveller. Thank you so much for the beautiful memory you gave us.
text_1bdaeca5: It was a great experience with Roxaval Travels. We spent quite comfortably hours throughout our journey and covered lots of beautiful places & attractive cities. Roxaval travels services were excellent and fulfilled all commitments by providing magnificent services. Specially, Mr. Bandulla Joyakodi was so helpful to explore beautiful & attractive places. Mr. Nashantha Fernando was quite friendly, helpful, & generous guy throughout our whole trip. Hence, the whole team of Roxaval deserves wealthier "5 Stars" & highly recommended.
